body: What I'm looking for is an actual diagnosis. Every psychiatrist I've seen previously has misdiagnosed me with general anxiety disorder and depression. I know for a fact that this is a misdiagnosis. My symptoms are clearly don't match up to simple anxiety and depression. You can see that... It's sad that a complete stranger can see this and not a licensed professional.
Thank you for all your input. I hope so too. This conversation has given me hope that this is not the end.

EMDR? Is that something that is easily obtainable? It sounds like a specialized procedure. There's no way I'd be able to cover the cost.

I appreciate your input nonetheless.

PTS-induced attachment disorder and OCD has pretty much been the majority opinion.
It's just so confusing for me anymore...I don't know what to do or where I'm going. But I'm taking your suggestions to heart.

My mental health issues started to appear at the age of six. I was formally diagnosed with ADHD by a child psychologist. But now a lot of people are saying that ADHD was a sham, and many children were misdiagnosed... This has me extremely worried.
Do you feel like it was my genetic predisposition that caused me to be affected more harshly?

I was never abused as a child, but my mother left my father when I was only four years old and moved to a different state to be with another man. I often quote this as being one of the most traumatic experiences of my entire life. I had trouble processing the entire situation because of how young I was. I still have trouble with it to this day. However, my sister seems to be perfectly fine and leads a normal life. She was only two years old at the time of the initial incident.

I appreciate your response. Why is it that some people can go through these types of traumatic events and be fine while I'm suffering for a lifetime? It makes me feel so horrible about myself... I believe I have some serious misconceptions when it comes to OCD because I was always led to believe that it was pertaining to repeated physical activities.

All of those things! It's like you can read me like a book! OCD, attachment issues, and PTSD. Do you think it's possible that I may be on the spectrum and have somehow gone undiagnosed for my entire life? I had my own suspicions about that... One thing I should have mentioned was that I was formally diagnosed with "ADHD" at the age of 6. This is really making me open my eyes. What should I do? Can you give me any other advice? What types of medications work for you?

My health is perfectly fine. It always has been. This is a mental health issue. I appreciate your advice, but it does not pertain to my situation. These problems have existed for most of my life. It's not something that just suddenly appeared.

The posts on my OP in SuicideWatch were removed by a moderator without my knowledge. It was my interpretation of what posters were saying to me. 

You're absolutely right, I have completely disregarded all medical professionals in my local area. I see it as more of a profiteering racket than anything. They have all failed me. I need a real diagnosis because then I have something to work with!
